breakdown.description: Output requests solution at T=1.1 but the Domain section specifies t in [0, 1].
breakdown.reason: The original prompt had a conflict between the time domain `t in [0, 1.0]` and the requested output time `T=1.1`. The ground truth resolved this by changing the output time to `T=1.0` to match the domain. The agent did the opposite; it changed the domain to `t in [0, 1.1]` and kept the output time at `T=1.1`. This does not match the correction made in the ground truth.
